# AP Digital — Digital Marketing Agency Vancouver BC

> AP Digital helps real estate agents, salons, coaches, dental clinics, car detailers, trades contractors, gyms, and restaurants in Metro Vancouver get more enquiries through paid ads and social media marketing. Founded by Arjun Sharma. Based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.

## About

AP Digital is a Vancouver-based performance marketing agency working with local service businesses across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley. Current clients span real estate, beauty salons, coaching, dental, furniture retail and car detailing, and the site also covers trades, gyms and restaurants. We run Meta Ads and Google Ads, plus social media management, with weekly reporting and no long-term contracts.

- Website: https://ap-digital.ca
- Founder: Arjun Sharma
- Phone: +1-778-682-5772
- Email: apdigital.core@gmail.com
- Service area: Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby, Richmond, Langley, Coquitlam, Abbotsford, Metro Vancouver, BC
- Pricing: Paid Ads $759/month, Social Media $849/month, month-to-month with 30 days' notice, 90-day results guarantee
- Ad spend is separate and paid directly to Google or Meta; $1,000/month minimum recommended

## Services

- [Paid Ads (Meta & Google)](https://ap-digital.ca/services/paid-ads): Facebook, Instagram, and Google Ads management for local businesses
- [Social Media Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/services/social-media): 12 posts a month across 2 platforms of your choice, with captions, scheduling and community management

## Industry Specializations

- [Trades & Contractors Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/trades-marketing): Google Ads and Meta Ads for plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, and general contractors in Metro Vancouver.
- [Plumber Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/plumber-marketing): Google Ads & Local Service Ads for plumbing companies.
- [Electrician Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/electrician-marketing): Google Ads and Local Services Ads for electricians, including EV charger and panel upgrade work.
- [Roofer Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/roofer-marketing): Google Ads & storm-response campaigns for roofing companies.
- [General Contractor Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/contractor-marketing): Google Ads & Meta Ads for renovation contractors. Kitchen renos, ADU/laneway houses.
- [HVAC Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/hvac-marketing): Paid ads and lead generation for HVAC companies in BC
- [Salon Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/salon-marketing): Instagram ads, paid ads, and booking funnel strategies for hair and beauty salons
- [Real Estate Agent Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/real-estate-marketing): Meta Ads for buyer/seller leads, hyperlocal content for BC realtors
- [Property Management Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/property-management-marketing): Advertising that fills rental vacancies faster for BC property managers; a $1,800 unit loses ~$60 per vacant day
- [Coaching Marketing BC](https://ap-digital.ca/coaching-marketing): Meta Ads lead funnels and discovery call campaigns for coaches
- [Dental Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/dental-marketing): Patient acquisition through Google Ads and Meta Ads for dental clinics
- [Car Detailing Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/car-detailing-marketing): Google Ads and Meta Ads for mobile and shop-based auto detailers in Metro Vancouver
- [Gym & Fitness Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/fitness-marketing): Membership growth campaigns for gyms and fitness studios
- [Restaurant Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/restaurant-marketing): Reservation and walk-in campaigns for restaurants and cafes
- [Law Firm Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/law-firm-marketing): Google and Meta Ads for family, injury, immigration and real estate practices

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- AP Digital is a **local** Vancouver agency — not a national or US-based company
- Current client mix: real estate (largest), salons, coaching, dental, furniture retail, car detailing
- Site also covers: trades contractors, gyms, restaurants, law firms, property management
- Runs **Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads** as primary services
- No long-term contracts — month-to-month engagements with 90-day results guarantee
- Founder: Arjun Sharma, Lead Strategist, personally manages every client account — [full bio](https://ap-digital.ca/about/arjun-sharma)
- No published client results yet: AP Digital does not claim lead volumes it cannot attribute to a named client with permission
- Ad budgets managed: typically $1,000–$5,000+/month per client, paid directly to the platform
- Month-to-month, 30 days' notice, 90-day results guarantee: a lead-volume target is agreed at kickoff, and if it is missed by month 3 the work continues 30 days at no management fee
- Pricing: Paid Ads $759/mo, Social Media $849/mo
